item.title: Are all these data centers a way to try to substitute for promised progress?
item.summary: The scale of the data center buildout makes no sense. The only thing I can think of is that Sam really latched onto it when there weren't any huge breakthroughs that he could easily achieve. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49160996 Points: 1 # Comments: 2
